bugs.name: Notifications settings page renders blank on a 390×844 mobile viewport
bugs.summary: At the Notifications settings route on a 390×844 viewport, the authenticated page consistently shows only the Uptime Kuma header and no settings content, including after refresh and settling.
bugs.expected: The Notifications settings page displays its settings content and controls at the requested route.
bugs.actual: The page shows the Uptime Kuma header, but the main area remains entirely blank with no notification settings controls. This persisted after navigation, refresh, and a six-second wait.
reproSteps: Set the browser viewport to 390×844 CSS pixels and load the provided authenticated admin session; do not change authentication details.
Wait for the page to load, refresh it, then wait six seconds.
Observe that only the Uptime Kuma header is visible and the main content area remains blank with no notification settings controls.
bugs.reason: At the assigned 390x844 viewport, Notifications and its setup/settings controls render after refresh and the six-second wait. The claimed blank main area does not occur.

bugs.name: Apprise notification setup Save leaves dialog open and does not add configuration
bugs.summary: The enabled Save action leaves the Apprise setup dialog open without confirmation, and the new configuration is absent from the notifications list after dismissal.
bugs.expected: Clicking Save on the populated Apprise setup form should save the integration and visibly return to the notifications list with the new configuration shown.
bugs.actual: Across repeated attempts, clicking the enabled Save button left the form open with the entered values and no setup-specific confirmation or error. After manually closing the dialog, the unique configuration name was not shown in the notifications list.
reproSteps: Authenticate as the authorized admin by loading the provided saved-auth session, then open /settings/notifications.
Click Set Up Notification and select “Apprise (Support 50+ Notification services).”

Enter the fresh friendly name “exp-othernotify-apprise-6b70cf72,” Apprise URL “json://example.invalid,” and title “exp-othernotify-test-6b70cf72.” Leave both “Default enabled” and “Apply on all existing monitors” unchecked.
Click the enabled Save button and observe the populated setup dialog remain open with no save confirmation or setup-specific error.
Manually close the dialog and observe that “exp-othernotify-apprise-6b70cf72” is absent from the visible notification list.
bugs.reason: Saving the populated Apprise form closes the dialog, shows Saved and adds the named configuration to the Notifications list. The reported silent no-op does not occur.
